policy_extraction.issuing_body: Personal Information Protection Commission (PIPC), South Korea
covered_actors: public sector organizations conducting privacy impact assessments
open source and API-based AI service providers
prohibited_practices: collecting sensitive information, unique identification information, personal information of children under 14, or illegally distributed personal information when using publicly available data for AI training

evidence.quote: AI 취약점 공격에 의한 개인정보 유ㆍ노출 등 위험을 최소화하기 위한 대책을 계획하고 있습니까?

오픈소스‧API 등 개발‧배포 방식 특성에 따라 AI 시스템 개발 및 운영 전 주기에 참여하는 관련 기업·기관의 권한 및 역할
AI 학습데이터의 보유기간을 정하고, 보유기간이 경과하거나 AI 학습·개발 또는 운영 종료 등으로 학습데이터가 불필요하게 되었을 때에는 지체 없이 파기하도록 계획하고 있습니까?
AI 시스템 개발 및 운영 전 주기에 참여하는 관련 기업·기관의 권한 및 역할, 정보주체 권리보장 책임, 협력체계 등을 명확히 정의하고 이를 계약서, 라이선스, 사용지침 등에 반영하도록 계획하고 있습니까?

policy_extraction.implementation_notes: This document is a draft (안) checklist of AI-specific evaluation items for Privacy Impact Assessments (PIA) under South Korean personal information protection law. Items cover: lawful basis for collecting personal data for AI training; safeguards for publicly collected data; third-party transfer and entrustment requirements; cross-border transfer requirements; retention and destruction of training data; security measures against AI vulnerability attacks; role/responsibility definition across the AI supply chain; transparency via privacy policies; acceptable use policy publication for generative AI; and data subject rights mechanisms including deletion of AI-generated facial/voice outputs.

risk_framing.rationale_summary: The document is a privacy impact assessment checklist for AI systems under South Korean data protection law. Its governance rationale centers on protecting individual data subjects' rights—consent, lawful basis, data minimization, deletion, and the right to remove AI-generated outputs of one's face or voice. This is quintessentially a fundamental-rights framing. Secondary consumer/public safety concerns appear in items addressing AI vulnerability attacks and inappropriate AI outputs.
